findings.rationale: Valve Steam before 2021-04-17, when a Source engine game is installed, allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary code because of a buffer overflow that occurs for a Steam invite after one click.
findings.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 2021-04-10

findings.title: CVE-2026-8053 in MongoDB 8.2.2 2008R2Plus SSL (64 bit) 8.2.2
findings.rationale:
An issue in MongoDB Server's time-series collection implementation allows an authenticated user with database write privileges to trigger an out-of-bounds memory write in the mongod process. The issue results from an inconsistency in the internal field-name-to-index mapping within the time-series bucket catalog. Under certain conditions this can result in arbitrary code execution.

This issue impacts MongoDB Server v5.0 versions prior to 5.0.33, v6.0 versions prior to 6.0.28, v7.0 versions prior to 7.0.34, v8.0 versions prior to 8.0.23, v8.2 versions prior to 8.2.9 and v8.3 versions prior to 8.3.2.

findings.title: CVE-2026-4148 in MongoDB 8.2.2 2008R2Plus SSL (64 bit) 8.2.2
findings.rationale: A use-after-free vulnerability can be triggered in sharded clusters by an authenticated user with the read role who issues a specially crafted $lookup or $graphLookup aggregation pipeline.

findings.title: CVE-2026-11933 in MongoDB 8.2.2 2008R2Plus SSL (64 bit) 8.2.2
findings.rationale: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in MongoDB Server's server-side JavaScript engine when converting BSON documents to JavaScript arrays. An authenticated user with read privileges who is able to run server-side JavaScript (for example, via $where or $function) can cause the server to access memory that has already been freed. This may result in disclosure of information from the mongod process memory or a denial of service through a server crash.

findings.title: CVE-2026-18691 in MongoDB 8.2.2 2008R2Plus SSL (64 bit) 8.2.2
findings.rationale: An issue in MongoDB Server's intra-cluster connection setup could allow a party with suitable network access to influence which authentication mechanism is used when one replica set member connects to another. Under certain conditions, this could cause the cluster's shared internal credential to be transmitted in a less-protected form, potentially allowing that credential to be recovered. If recovered, the credential could be used to authenticate as the internal superuser to nodes in the deployment.
findings.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 8.2.12

findings.title: CVE-2026-18692 in MongoDB 8.2.2 2008R2Plus SSL (64 bit) 8.2.2
findings.rationale: An issue in MongoDB Server's handling of timeseries bucket lifecycle could allow an authenticated user with write privileges to cause an internal reference to be used after the underlying memory has been freed. Subsequent operations could then result in a server crash or, potentially, execution of unintended code.
findings.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 8.2.12

findings.title: CVE-2020-15530 in Steam 2.10.91.91
findings.rationale: An issue was discovered in Valve Steam Client 2.10.91.91. The installer allows local users to gain NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges because some parts of %PROGRAMFILES(X86)%\Steam and/or %COMMONPROGRAMFILES(X86)%\Steam have weak permissions during a critical time window. An attacker can make this time window arbitrarily long by using opportunistic locks.

findings.title: CVE-2019-15315 in Steam 2.10.91.91
findings.rationale: Valve Steam Client for Windows through 2019-08-16 allows privilege escalation (to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM) because local users can replace the current versions of SteamService.exe and SteamService.dll with older versions that lack the CVE-2019-14743 patch.
findings.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 2019-08-16

findings.title: CVE-2019-17180 in Steam 2.10.91.91
findings.rationale: Valve Steam Client before 2019-09-12 allows placing or appending partially controlled filesystem content, as demonstrated by file modifications on Windows in the context of NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM. This could lead to denial of service, elevation of privilege, or unspecified other impact.

findings.title: CVE-2026-70336 in Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User) 1.106.3

findings.title: CVE-2026-41109 in Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User) 1.106.3

findings.title: CVE-2026-57102 in Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User) 1.106.3

findings.title: CVE-2026-58043 in Node.js 24.11.1
findings.rationale:
A flaw in Node.js Permission Model enforcement can over-grant filesystem access across radix-tree prefix boundaries.

Under `--permission`, an attacker who is granted access to one path can abuse boundary handling to read from or write to paths outside the intended filesystem allowlist.

This vulnerability affects Node.js **main**, **22.x**, **24.x**, and **26.x**.
findings.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 24.18.0

findings.title: CVE-2026-45482 in Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User) 1.106.3
findings.rationale: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio Code allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally.

findings.title: CVE-2026-50520 in Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User) 1.106.3
findings.rationale: Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command ('command injection') in Visual Studio Code allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code locally.

findings.title: CVE-2026-48617 in Node.js 24.11.1
findings.rationale: A flaw in Node.js Permission Model enforcement allows Bypass via `process.report.writeReport()` Path Misvalidation. This can lead to confidentiality impact or bypass of the intended security boundary under affected configurations. This vulnerability affects all supported release lines: **Node.js 22**, **Node.js 24**, and **Node.js 26**.
findings.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 24.16.0

findings.title: CVE-2026-81378 in Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User) 1.106.3

findings.title: CVE-2026-81379 in Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User) 1.106.3

findings.title: CVE-2024-9287 in Python 3.14.0 (64-bit) 3.14.150.0
findings.rationale: A vulnerability has been found in the CPython `venv` module and CLI where path names provided when creating a virtual environment were not quoted properly, allowing the creator to inject commands into virtual environment "activation" scripts (ie "source venv/bin/activate"). This means that attacker-controlled virtual environments are able to run commands when the virtual environment is activated. Virtual environments which are not created by an attacker or which aren't activated before being used (ie "./venv/bin/python") are not affected.

findings.title: CVE-2026-42334 in mongoose 9.0.1
findings.rationale:
### Impact

This vulnerability allows bypassing Mongoose’s sanitizeFilter query sanitization mechanism via the `$nor` operator.

When sanitizeFilter is enabled, Mongoose wraps query operators in `$eq` to neutralize them. However, prior to the fix, `$nor` was not included in the set of logical operators that are recursively sanitized. Because `$nor` accepts an array (like `$and` and `$or`), and arrays do not trigger `hasDollarKeys()`, malicious operators such as `$ne`, `$gt`, or `$regex` could be injected inside a `$nor` clause without being sanitized.

This may lead to:

- Authentication bypass
- Unauthorized data access
- Data exfiltration

**Affected users:**

Applications that:

- Explicitly enable sanitizeFilter
- Pass unsanitized user-controlled input directly into query methods (e.g., `Model.findOne(req.body)`) and rely on `sanitizeFilter` to strip out query selectors

Applications that validate input schemas, whitelist fields, or avoid passing raw request bodies into queries are

findings.title: CVE-2026-13346 in pip 25.2
findings.rationale: pip would incorrectly handle doubly-encoded package URLs from indexes

findings.title: CVE-2026-23863 in WhatsApp 2.2637.100.0
findings.rationale: An attachment spoofing issue in WhatsApp for Windows prior to v2.3000.1032164386.258709 could have allowed maliciously formatted documents with embedded NUL bytes in the filename to be shown in the application as one type of file but run as an executable when opened. We have not seen evidence of exploitation in the wild.

findings.title: CVE-2026-4926 in path-to-regexp 8.3.0
findings.rationale:
### Impact

A bad regular expression is generated any time you have multiple sequential optional groups (curly brace syntax), such as `{a}{b}{c}:z`. The generated regex grows exponentially with the number of groups, causing denial of service.

### Patches

Fixed in version 8.4.0.

### Workarounds

Limit the number of sequential optional groups in route patterns. Avoid passing user-controlled input as route patterns.

findings.key: sca:CIS Microsoft Windows 11 Enterprise Benchmark v3.0.0:26133
findings.title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Public: Settings: Apply local firewall rules' is set to 'No'.
findings.policy_id: CIS Microsoft Windows 11 Enterprise Benchmark v3.0.0
findings.rationale: When in the Public profile, there should be no special local firewall exceptions per computer. These settings should be managed by a centralized policy.
findings.official_remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to No: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Firewall Properties\Public Profile\Settings Customize\Apply local firewall rules.

recommendations.title: Update Visual Studio Code to fix critical vulnerability
steps: Open Visual Studio Code and go to Help > Check for Updates.
If an update is available, install it immediately.
Restart Visual Studio Code after the update completes.
Verify the installed version is 1.136.2 or newer by checking the About section in Help.
If no update is available through the app, use PowerShell to run 'winget upgrade Microsoft.VisualStudioCode.User'.

recommendations.title: Update or remove Steam to fix CVE-2021-30481
steps: Open Steam, go to Help > Check for Updates, and install the latest version.
If no update is available, uninstall Steam through Settings > Apps > Apps & Features.
Verify the update by checking the version in Steam > About Steam.
Ensure no other Steam-related CVEs are present by checking the official Steam security page.
Restart your PC after updating or uninstalling to apply changes.
Confirm the fix by running a new Wazuh scan.
recommendations.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 2021-04-10

recommendations.title: Update MongoDB to fix critical vulnerability
steps: Open MongoDB's installer or updater (Help > Check for Updates) and install version 8.2.13 or newer.
Verify the update was successful by checking the installed version in the MongoDB application settings.
Restart any services or applications that depend on MongoDB after the update.
Confirm the vulnerability is resolved by checking Wazuh for the finding status after the update.
If the update is not available through MongoDB's updater, download and install the latest version from MongoDB's official website.

recommendations.title: Update Node.js to fix critical vulnerability
steps: Open Node.js installer and check for updates via Help > Check for Updates
Install the latest version of Node.js from https://nodejs.org
Verify the installed version by running `node -v` in PowerShell
Ensure the version is newer than 24.18.0
Restart any applications using Node.js to apply changes
Check for any remaining vulnerabilities using Wazuh again
recommendations.official_remediation: Package less than or equal to 24.18.0

recommendations.title: Update Python to fix CVE-2024-9287
steps: Open PowerShell as Administrator and run: `winget upgrade Python.Python.3.14`
Check the installed version by running: `python --version`
Verify the update was successful by confirming the version is 3.14.7 or newer
If winget is not available, download the latest Python installer from the official website and reinstall
Restart any applications that rely on Python to ensure the update takes effect

recommendations.title: Update mongoose to fix CVE-2026-42334
steps: Open a terminal or command prompt in the Node.js project that uses mongoose.
Run the command: `npm install mongoose@latest` to upgrade to the fixed version.
Verify the update by checking the `package.json` file for the new version number.
Restart the application to ensure the updated package is used.
Check the application logs for any errors related to mongoose after the update.

recommendations.title: Upgrade pip to fix security vulnerability
steps: Open PowerShell as administrator
Run command: python -m pip install --upgrade pip
Verify upgrade: python -m pip --version
Check if version is 26.2 or newer
Restart any affected applications

recommendations.title: Update WhatsApp to fix CVE-2026-23863
steps: Open WhatsApp, go to Help > Check for Updates.
Download and install the latest version if an update is available.
Verify the version in the app settings matches 2.3000.1032164386.258709 or newer.
Restart WhatsApp after the update completes.
Check for any remaining updates in the app to ensure it is fully up to date.

recommendations.title: Update path-to-regexp to fix CVE-2026-4926
steps: Navigate to the Node.js project that uses path-to-regexp.
Open a terminal or command prompt in the project directory.
Run the command `npm install path-to-regexp@latest` to update the package.
Verify the update by checking the package version in `package.json` or using `npm list path-to-regexp`.
Restart any applications that depend on this package to ensure the fix is applied.

recommendations.title: Set 'Apply local firewall rules' to 'No' in Public profile
steps: Open the Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security by searching for it in the Start menu.
In the left pane, click 'Windows Firewall Properties'.
Select the 'Public Profile' tab.
Under 'Settings', click 'Customize' next to 'Apply local firewall rules'.
In the dialog, select 'No' and click 'OK'.
Click 'OK' again in the Windows Firewall Properties window to save changes.
recommendations.official_remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to No: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Firewall Properties\Public Profile\Settings Customize\Apply local firewall rules.
